# Vidnexa Player

> Vidnexa Player is a free Android media player by Authenticode Solution. It plays 4K and 8K HDR video and 200+ formats, with a music player and equalizer, gallery, file manager and Network Player, and needs no sign-up. Download: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.vidnexa.videoplayer
